tasks.short: Estimate supply amounts and their cost.

steps.what: Estimate the required supplies for these dishes.
Count ingredients on hand for those supplies.
Fetch the unit prices of the required ingredients.
Fill amounts and costs on the supply sheet.
Check the costs against the supplies she counted.
Decide which supply amounts to buy.

tasks.design: She writes the dishes, the portions and the stock count. A fetch from the {PARTNER_PORTAL} writes a price card where the ingredient code matches, and the {SPREADSHEET} fills each amount and cost from those quantities and prices. She checks every line and decides the buy.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recipe quantities sat in a paper book and supplier prices sat on a portal, so the multiply waited for a late sheet.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored quantity per portion and a matched unit price make covers times quantity times price ordinary configuration.
tasks.still_hard: She still walks the stores, and a new dish or a phone quote stays blank until she types it. She still decides the buy.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which delivery will actually arrive and which dish the brigade can still drop.

ambition.what: She sees the supply cost for this service before she locks the buy, on days the quantities and prices are already stored.

tasks.altitude: The stores and the buy decision stay hers. Only the price card and the supply sheet move.

reach.task: Keep each recipe's quantity per portion
reach.learn: Which dishes she will cook this service

reach.task: Match supplier item codes to ingredients
reach.learn: Which code she trusts for this buy

evidence.claim: Apicbase rolls ingredient prices up to a portion cost, applies connected suppliers' price changes, and adds labour for a prime cost.
Walking the stores and choosing the buy are not a portion-cost roll-up. This range uses neither a forecast case nor a waste case.

assumptions: Before the fetch she writes dish, portions, ingredient, quantity per portion and unit. The portal must already hold supplier item code, unit price and pack size, matched by the purchasing clerk. A missing code or price leaves that line blank and she types it in the check.
The sheet is an internal estimate. It does not create a purchase order and it does not message a supplier.
The clerk's code-map upkeep is other-role time below, not her old lookup moved off the books. Her one incremental hour is a new ingredient quantity she adds after the check.
unknowns: Whether this supplier portal shows a unit price for each ingredient code the clerk has matched.
research_questions: Which ingredients on the current menu still have no supplier item code?

already_counted.description: Reading each filled line against the stock count and typing a price the portal left blank.

incremental.description: Adding a quantity for a new ingredient the sous has not filed, after the check is done.
Purchasing clerk keeps the supplier item code matched to the ingredient.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeating weekday lunch where most dishes already have a stored quantity and an item code. Low is a banquet of new dishes where she still phones prices and walks every store. High is that lunch, and the stock count and the buy decision do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate the food budget and the purchasing.

steps.what: Gather the planning figures for these food operations.
Draft the budgeting note for those operations.

loop.input: The spend totals and the planning choices she wrote in s1.
loop.output: Budget lines that quote only those totals and choices and say what the month's food spend is for.
loop.check: Each line quotes a spend total or a planning choice she wrote, and the sentence says what that money is for. A line that adds a site, a supplier, a person or a figure she did not write fails.
loop.stop: One pass. A failing line is dropped and not repaired. If every line fails, the note stays blank and she writes it.
loop.why_not_simpler: A field copy cannot write what the money is for.

steps.what: Check the budgeting note quotes her planning figures.
Confirm the budgeting note for these operations.
Coordinate purchasing with the cooks and the buyer.
Place the purchasing orders with the suppliers herself.

tasks.design: She types the spend totals and the planning choices. A draft in {DOCS} writes budget lines that quote only those totals and choices, and she checks every line before she confirms the note. She coordinates the sites in the room and places each supplier order herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan, the spend and the supplier talks lived in different sheets and in the room, so a note could not know which figure she trusted.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded draft can quote only the spend totals and the planning choices she has already written, and say what the money is for.
tasks.still_hard: Agreeing the month with the sites, and placing the orders, stay with her. A site whose figures are missing leaves that part of the note blank.
tasks.human_edge: She holds the argument between the sites about what the month can afford.
tasks.altitude: The meeting and the orders stay hers. Only the budget draft moves.

reach.task: Send the period food spend as a total
reach.learn: Which total she will stand behind in the meeting
Which quote she is ready to place

evidence.claim: Articles 27(1)(k) and 27(1)(l) of the Dutch works-councils act give consent rights on staff data and on systems fit to monitor attendance, behaviour or performance.
A draft that quotes figures she typed is not the budget decision, and it is not a staff-monitoring record. The meeting and the supplier orders stay with her.

assumptions: Before the draft she writes site, period, food-spend total and the planning choice in her own words. The draft may not add a site, a supplier, a person or a figure. If every line fails, the note stays blank.
The note holds food-spend totals, not named staff and not an attendance score. No machine files the note and no machine places an order. She places every order herself.
The one incremental hour is a site total that arrives after she has already checked the note.
unknowns: Whether each site can send food spend as a total, or only as named staff hours.
research_questions: Which sites still send their spend after the month has started?

already_counted.description: Reading each budget line and striking one that adds a site, a supplier or a figure she did not write.

incremental.description: Rewriting the note when a site's spend arrives after she has checked it.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A month where she has already typed the spend total for every site. Low is a month where two sites arrive late and she rewrites the note. High stays under the net because the meeting and the orders stay hers.

tasks.short: Price menu items from recipe costs.

steps.what: Analyze these recipes and name labor and overhead.
Fetch the food cost of these recipes.
Fill prices from food, labor and overhead costs.
Check each price uses the recipes and the costs she named.
Assign prices to these menu items.
Record those prices in the point of sale.

tasks.design: She confirms the recipe quantities, the labor minutes and the overhead rate. A fetch from the {PARTNER_PORTAL} writes the food-cost card, and the {SPREADSHEET} fills the price lines from that card plus the rate she named. She assigns each menu price, and a separate write records only that confirmed price in the point of sale.
tasks.previous_blocker: Food cost, labor minutes and overhead sat on a sheet she rebuilt whenever a supplier price moved.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored recipe quantities and a supplier price card make the prime-cost sum a configuration, and she still sets the price.
tasks.still_hard: She still chooses the price the guest pays. A recipe with no stored quantity, or a price the portal did not return, is costed by hand. The price record does not write the allergen text guests must still receive.
tasks.human_edge: She knows which price the regulars will pay and which dish is there to sell the rest.

ambition.what: She confirms a menu price when a stored supplier price changes, before the next service, instead of waiting for a monthly sheet.

tasks.altitude: Choosing the guest price stays hers. The cost card, the price sheet and the point-of-sale record move, and the record waits for her confirmation.

reach.task: Name the overhead rate menu prices may use
reach.learn: Which rate she has confirmed for this menu

reach.task: Keep the recipe quantities the price uses

evidence.claim: Apicbase rolls ingredient prices up to a portion cost, applies connected suppliers' price changes, and adds labour for a prime cost.
Guests must get information on the 14 EU allergens.
In 2022 only 41% of inspected horeca complied, and often the allergen information was not available in writing or electronically.
Setting the price a guest pays is not the portion-cost roll-up. The point-of-sale write does not produce allergen text, and this range uses no vendor time figure.

assumptions: Before the fetch she writes recipe, portion, ingredient quantity, labor minutes and overhead rate. The portal fields are item code and unit price. The purchasing clerk's code-map upkeep is counted on the supply estimate and is not counted again here. A blank price stays blank.

The point-of-sale write stores only the price she confirmed, for the portion and the rate she named. A change to those inputs voids the approval. The write does not publish a guest page and does not write allergen text.
The one incremental hour is re-entering the overhead rate when finance changes it between menus.
unknowns: Whether the point of sale accepts a price write from outside the till.
research_questions: Which current recipes have no stored quantity per portion?

already_counted.description: Reading each price line against the recipe quantities, the labor minutes and the overhead rate she named.

incremental.description: Re-entering the overhead rate when finance changes it between menus.

approvals.approved_version: The menu price she assigned in s5 for the portion, labor minutes and overhead rate she named in s1. A change to those inputs voids this approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A set menu whose recipes, labor minutes and overhead rate are already written. Low is a week of new dishes with no stored quantity. High is that set menu, and she still assigns every price.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Name the menus and the service for these kitchens.
Fill the preparation order for those kitchens.
Check the preparation order lists only those kitchens.
Direct the cooking activities on the pass.
Supervise food preparation in the other kitchens.

tasks.design: She names the dishes, the kitchens and the service time. The {SPREADSHEET} fills a preparation order from the station sequence she stored, and she checks that it adds no dish. She directs the pass and supervises the kitchens with that sheet in her hand.
tasks.previous_blocker: The preparation order was a board she rewrote at the pass, and no list knew which kitchens were open.
tasks.enabler_now: Once she names the dishes and the service time, a sheet can sort them by a station sequence she already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Directing the pass and supervising the kitchens stay in the room. A menu that changes at service makes the sheet stale, and a dish with no station is left off.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the pass and moves a cook before a dish is late. A sheet cannot see the room.
tasks.altitude: The pass and the kitchens stay hers. Only the preparation sheet moves, and it does not time a cook.

reach.task: Name the service time for each sitting
Keep the station sequence for each dish
reach.learn: Which dish she has pulled off the pass

evidence.claim: Annex III 4(b) covers task allocation by individual behaviour or traits and performance monitoring.
Articles 27(1)(k) and 27(1)(l) of the Dutch works-councils act give consent rights on staff data and on systems fit to monitor attendance, behaviour or performance.
Sorting dishes by a station sequence she stored is not directing the pass. The sheet does not rank a cook and does not record a cook's time.

assumptions: Before the sheet she writes dish, kitchen, service time and station. The sheet sorts only dishes she named, by the station sequence she stored. A dish with no station is left off.

The sheet is a list in her hand. It does not send a message, it does not page a cook, and it does not record anyone's time. There is no model call, so the upkeep hour is the only extra and the run cost is none.
The one incremental hour is striking a dish that runs out after she has checked the sheet.
unknowns: Whether the works council treats a preparation list as a tool that could monitor staff.
research_questions: Which dishes on the current menus have no stored station?

already_counted.description: Reading the preparation order and striking a dish or a kitchen she did not name.

incremental.description: Striking a dish that runs out after the preparation order was checked.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A service whose dishes and stations she named before the pass. Low is a service where the menu changes at the pass and the sheet is unused. High is a stable service, and directing and supervising do not shrink.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still the stores, the buy, the budget meeting, the menu prices and the pass. Only the price card, the supply sheet, the budget draft, the price sheet, the menu-price record and the preparation sheet move.
reach: The sous chef keeps each recipe's ingredient quantity per portion, so the sheets can quote it.
The purchasing clerk matches each supplier item code to an ingredient and leaves the price blank when the code is missing.
The finance partner names the overhead rate the chef may use on a menu price.
The floor supervisor names the service time before the preparation sheet is sorted.
skills_to_grow: Reject a supply line whose amount she did not count or whose price the portal did not return.
Reject a budget line that adds a site, a supplier or a figure she did not write.
Reject a menu price whose food cost does not match the recipe she confirmed.
Direct the pass from the room, and refuse a sheet that times or ranks a cook.
role.ambitious_version: When a supplier price changes on a stored recipe, she confirms the menu price before service, and the stores, the buy, the budget meeting and the pass stay hers.
